title: Taal Volcano records 29 quakes, 20 tremors in 24 hours

blocks.text: UCENA CITY — Taal Volcano recorded 29 volcanic earthquakes and 20 volcanic tremors over 24 hours, indicating continued unrest, the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) reported Friday. The volcanic tremors lasted between one and 11 minutes each. From Oct. 20 to 22, the volcano recorded 10 volcanic earthquakes and nine tremors, following 43 volcanic earthquakes and 10 tremors on Oct. 19, according to Phivolcs’ morning bulletin.
